t: You are looking at Tower 42, a 183-metre skyscraper in the City of London. Many people still call it the NatWest Tower. It opened in 1980 as London's first skyscraper, and at the time it was the tallest building in the United Kingdom. It was designed by R Seifert and Partners. Richard Seifert, the Swiss-British architect behind the firm, is best known for this tower and for Centre Point. Pell Frischmann was the engineer.
